description: Repairs r-expr-1b/route-recordset-filter-sort: the filter named a column the recordset did not select. Asks which functions the expression service evaluates in a Recordset.Filter and Sort over Mx, with ID, N, T, D, DT and Y selected and every Filter and Sort on its own fresh dynaset (Errors after the put and after OpenRecordset); then the narrow SELECT ID, N, T recordset with the filter on the unselected D, a valid filter on N as control, and Sort 'NoSuchField' on a fresh narrow and a fresh full recordset with no earlier filter. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
